339-677-3480-8249.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Defiant Salvager by sacrificing Jegantha, putting a +1/+1 counter on Defiant Salvager
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

813-4113-5895.description:
Cast Splash Portal by tapping Scholar of the Ages due to Splash Portal's convoke ability, blinking Scholar of the Ages.
When Scholar of the Ages enters, it triggers, returning Splash Portal from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

1477-2558-4186-6689-8181.description:
Cast Sword of the Meek by paying {2}.
When Sword of the Meek enters, Golbez triggers.
Holding priority, activate Extruder by sacrificing Sword of the Meek, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature.
Resolve the Golbez trigger, causing you to surveil 1.
Denzilore triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token.
When the Squirrel enters, Sword of the Meek triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to the Squirrel.
Repeat from step 2.
Activate Extruder by sacrificing Sword of the Meek, putting a +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak.
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token.
When the Squirrel enters, Sword of the Meek triggers, returning Sword of the Meek from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to the Squirrel.
Repeat.

147-5686-8129.easyPrerequisites: There's a creature card in your graveyard.
147-5686-8129.notablePrerequisites: There are at least seven cards in your graveyard.
147-5686-8129.description:
Cast Stitch Together by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, targeting Stitch Together.
Holding priority, activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage, creating a Blood token.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Stitch Together
Resolve the Stitch Together copy, returning Dualcaster Mage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

969-3259-3699.notablePrerequisites:
At least one opponent cannot block creatures you control.
You control a creature token.
969-3259-3699.description:
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached and Cadira, triggering Breath of Fury and Cadira.
Resolve the Cadira trigger, creating at least one creature token.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to a creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.

1580-2921-4871-7316.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Reassembling Skeleton.
When Reassembling Skeleton dies, Pitiless Plunderer and Rat King trigger, creating a creature token and a Treasure token.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Reassembling Skeleton by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

240-4927-5470-6798.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability, causing you to surveil 1
Repeat from step 2.

Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Realm Seekers.
When Realm Seekers dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Repeat.

Activate Relic of Legends' second ability by tapping Gran-Gran, adding {1}
Gran-Gran triggers, causing you to loot.

Repeat.

Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Lyla triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Repeat.

1594-2707-5751-6504.description:
Activate Conjurer's Bauble by tapping and sacrificing it, putting a land from your graveyard onto the bottom of your library and causing you to draw the land.
Cast Conjurer's Bauble from your graveyard for its retrace cost by paying {0} and discarding a land.
Repeat.

2034-4720-4853-4888.description:
Activate Puppet's Conjurer by paying {U} and tapping it, creating a 0/1 Homunculus artifact creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Homunculus, adding {C}{C}.
When the Homunculus dies, Dross Scorpion triggers, untapping Puppet's Conjurer.
Activate Stonework Packbeast by paying {2}, adding {U}.
Repeat.

1437-3569.notablePrerequisites: Myojin of Cryptic Dreams has at least two indestructible counters on it.
1437-3569.description:
Cast Pollenbright Druid by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, activate Myojin by removing an indestructible counter from it, copying the Pollenbright Druid spell three times.
Resolve the first Pollenbright Druid spell.
When the Pollenbright Druid token enters the battlefield, it triggers, putting an indestructible counter on Myojin.
Repeat from step 2.
1437-3569.notes: This combo results in infinite copies of the Pollenbright Druid spell on the stack, which you can then resolve to infinitely proliferate. This can put infinite indestructible counters on Myojin to infinitely copy any permanent spell(s) you cast in the future.

3308-3946-4935.description:
Play Glacial Chasm either from your hand or from your graveyard.
When Glacial Chasm enters the battlefield, its second ability triggers, causing you to sacrifice another land you control.
Play any land from your graveyard.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, Glacial Chasm's cumulative upkeep ability triggers, allowing you to choose not to pay the cost and sacrifice it instead.
Repeat.

209-1144-3510.description:
Life and Limb and Yavimaya cause all lands to be 1/1 Saproling creatures that are also Forests in addition to their other types.
Because Linvala prevents your opponents from activating abilities of creatures they control, your opponents cannot activate abilities of lands or creatures they control.

2499-3821-3859.notablePrerequisites: You control up to five lands that can tap to produce at least {2}{U}{B}.
2499-3821-3859.description:
Activate up to five lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {2}{U}{B}.
Cast Peregrine Drake by paying {4}{U}.
Peregrine Drake enters the battlefield, triggering its ability twice.
Resolve the first Peregrine Drake trigger, untapping the five lands.
Activate the five lands by tapping them, adding at least {2}{U}{B}.
Resolve the second Peregrine Drake trigger, untapping the five lands.
Cast Cavern Harpy by paying {U}{B}.
Cavern Harpy enters the battlefield, triggering its ability twice, returning Cavern Harpy and Peregrine Drake from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

1170-3518-5006.description:
Cast Lion's Eye Diamond from your graveyard by paying {0}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Lurrus.
Activate Lion's Eye Diamond by discarding your hand and sacrificing it.
